title: Atrium 0.31.0
notes:
This release overhauls Atrium's embedded PostgreSQL 17 runtime, schema, search, multi-device sync, semantic memory, and backup capabilities, bringing `pgvector` semantic recall, English full-text search, real-time `LISTEN/NOTIFY` sync wakeups, Browser bookmark/history storage & sync, and history search in both the macOS app and web UI.

## Added

- **Bundled `pgvector` (`v0.8.7`) & Hybrid Semantic Memory (`scripts/postgres/fetch.py`, `PostgresSchema`, `MemoryEmbeddings`, `PostgresMemoryStore`)**:
  - Compiled and staged `pgvector` v0.8.7 alongside embedded PostgreSQL 17 with SHA-256 verification and `ThirdPartyNotices/pgvector-LICENSE`.
  - Added `vector(512)` `embedding` and `embedding_model` columns with HNSW cosine indexes (`vector_cosine_ops`) on `memory_claims` and `memory_sessions`.
  - Added `MemoryEmbeddingService` supporting optional OpenAI-compatible `/embeddings` endpoints (`MemorySettings.embeddingModel`) and zero-setup on-device 512-dim `NLEmbedding` vectors executed off the cooperative thread pool via `BlockingIO.run`.
  - Upgraded `memory_search` to combine `ILIKE` substring scoring, English `tsvector`/`ts_rank_cd` full-text search, and pgvector cosine similarity, plus background `backfillMissingEmbeddings` maintenance.
- **Full-Text Search & History Search UI (`TimelineSearchBar`, `MainWindowController`, `MainMenu`, `web/src/routes/Tasks.svelte`)**:
  - Added schema v5 stored `tsvector` generated columns and GIN indexes across `sessions`, `transcript_items`, `memory_claims`, `memory_sessions`, `agent_messages`, `browser_bookmarks`, and `browser_history`.
  - Added `⌘⇧F` (`Search History…`) in the macOS app with debounced inline search (`TimelineSearchBar`) and keyboard navigation across `SessionSearchHit` results.
  - Enabled `history/search` for web clients (`DaemonServer.remoteWebMethods`) and added a debounced search bar in the Web UI (`Tasks.svelte`).
- **Browser Bookmarks & History in PostgreSQL (`PostgresBrowserStore`, `BrowserStore`, `atriumd`)**:
  - Added `browser_bookmark_folders`, `browser_bookmarks`, and `browser_history` tables (schema v5) synchronized across devices via `PostgresSyncEngine` (10 syncable tables).
  - Added `browser/*` daemon RPCs and `BrowserDaemonBridge` in `BrowserStore` with one-time non-destructive `importLegacyIfEmpty`, write-through persistence, 3-second visit coalescing, and FTS/trigram address bar suggestions while preserving standalone local JSON fallback.
- **Database Backup, Usage Statistics & Tombstone Purge (`EmbeddedPostgresHost`, `PostgresSessionStore`, `MemoryPage`, `atriumd`)**:
  - Added `EmbeddedPostgresHost.dumpDatabase(to:)` (`pg_dump -Fc -Z 6`) and `storage/backup` RPC, exposed in Settings → Memory & Storage as **Backup…** with `NSSavePanel`.
  - Added `PostgresSessionStore.usageStats()` (`StorageUsageStats`) and `storage/stats` RPC surfaced in `MemoryPage` (database size, task/message/claim counts, pgvector status, agent breakdown).
  - Added `PostgresSchema.purgeExpiredTombstones(database:olderThanDays:now:)` (90-day retention) scheduled periodically in `atriumd`.

## Changed

- **PostgreSQL 17 Tuning & Connection Pooling (`EmbeddedPostgresHost`, `PostgresDatabase`)**:
  - Configured embedded `atrium.conf` with `shared_buffers = '128MB'`, `effective_cache_size = '512MB'`, `random_page_cost = 1.1`, `wal_level = minimal`, `max_wal_senders = 0`, `log_min_duration_statement = 500`, `statement_timeout = '30s'`, `lock_timeout = '10s'`, and `idle_in_transaction_session_timeout = '60s'`, plus automatic 5 MB log trimming on startup.
  - Added `PostgresSSLMode.verifyCA` (`verify-ca`) and tuned pool limits (`unixSocket` min=1/max=12, `tcp` min=0/max=4).
- **Schema v5 Cleanup, Bulk `UNNEST` Writes & Concurrency Safety (`PostgresSchema`, `PostgresSessionStore`, `PostgresMemoryStore`, `PostgresAgentHistory`, `PostgresSyncEngine`)**:
  - Dropped 3 redundant v1 trigram indexes, optimized hot B-Tree indexes (`idx_sessions_created`, `idx_sessions_parent`, `idx_transcript_session_user_seq`, indexed `sessions.native_session_id`), and eliminated the `ROW_NUMBER()` subquery in `loadHistoryPage` with connection reuse (`withConnection`).
  - Replaced per-row write loops with bulk `UNNEST` upserts/soft-deletes across `transcript_items`, `memory_sessions`, `memory_claims`, `memory_forgetting`, and all 10 `PostgresSyncEngine` transfer methods.
  - Added `IS DISTINCT FROM` write guards and revision-cache pre-checks (`PostgresSessionStore`, `Session` debounced writes using `SET LOCAL synchronous_commit = off` and immediate flushes using synchronous commit).
  - Added transaction-scoped `pg_advisory_xact_lock` serialization in `PostgresMemoryStore` and `PostgresAgentHistoryStore`, SQL `normalized_text` dedupe, structured `memory_forgetting` columns, and SQL `ILIKE` trigram pre-filtering.
  - Added transactional `sync_xid xid8` visibility stamps and `LISTEN/NOTIFY` (`atrium_sync`) push wakeups to `PostgresSyncEngine`, while skipping redundant `sync_state` writes on 0-row syncs.
- **Test Coverage**:
  - Added `PostgresBrowserStoreTests` and `BrowserBridgeTests`, and expanded `PostgresStorageTests`, `PostgresSessionStoreTests`, `PostgresSyncEngineTests`, `PostgresMemoryAndAgentTests`, `RemoteHardeningTests`, `test_postgres_fetch.py`, `MainMenuTests`, and web `actions.test.ts`.

## Requirements

- Apple silicon Mac running macOS 27 or later.

title: Atrium 0.30.2
notes:
This maintenance release hardens Atrium's agent harness prompts, subagent isolation, prompt-caching layout, untrusted-input boundaries, and memory/background prompt consistency.

## Fixed

- **System prompt ordering & window-reset memory refresh (`SystemPrompt`, `AgentServer`, `NativeRuntime`, `AgentSession`)**:
  - Unified custom/role `append` injection before `## Environment` and trailing memory in `SystemPrompt.components` / `build`, eliminating post-hoc appends that could be stripped when resetting system memory.
  - Fixed `AgentSession` evaluating `requestSystem` before `prepareContext(...)` so `refreshSystemMemoryOnReset()` applies on the first request of a reset window.
  - Added explicit `## Sandbox` and `## Git` headings with clear section separation in composed system prompts.
- **Subagent prompt isolation & `delegate` allowlist enforcement (`SystemPrompt.childSystem`, `Subagents`, `AgentSession`)**:
  - Replaced root-only guidance (`ask_user`, `monitor`, `background_task`, `memory_save`, `memory_forget`, `delegate`) in child system prompts with mode-specific `explore` (strictly read-only) and `general` subtask scopes while preserving custom test prefixes.
  - Fixed `SubagentConfiguration.init` so an invalid effort on an allowed model keeps the allowed model with its default effort instead of falling back to a potentially unallowed parent model, and stopped `SubagentConfiguration.call(_:parent:)` from overwriting explicit disallowed models before refusal.
  - Hid `delegate` and delegation nudges when no allowed subagent model is configured, and restricted `delegate`'s schema/description to allowed models with an explicit `Default model when omitted`.
- **Always-On Agent, Chief & Automation prompt accuracy (`AlwaysOnAgentPrompt`, `SessionStore`, `Session`, `ChiefToolCatalog`, `AutomationTools`)**:
  - Removed non-existent `session_create_related` references from `AlwaysOnAgentPrompt` and gated worker-orchestration instructions on the `.chief` role (`instructions(canOrchestrateWorkers:)`).
  - Structured `ChiefToolCatalog.instructions` into clear sections (`## Worker Sessions`, `## Model Selection`, `## Lifecycle & Verification`, `## Authority Boundaries`).
  - Split `AutomationTools.instructions` into `browserInstructions` and `computerInstructions`, omitting computer-use instructions in fenced sessions.
- **Untrusted data isolation & multimodal framing (`PromptXML`, `MCPClient`, `AgentSession`, `MemoryClaims`, `MemoryMaintenance`, `AgentMemoryRunner`, `ModelProvider`, `ContinuityPack`)**:
  - Added closing-tag escaping (`PromptXML`) and explicit data-not-instructions framing for MCP server instructions, working notes/transcripts/summaries, subdirectory instructions, skills, and memory extraction inputs.
  - Added untrusted-image framing for tool-returned images on OpenAI Responses and Anthropic Messages APIs matching OpenAI Chat.
  - Skipped empty sections in `ContinuityPack.build` instead of emitting empty headings.

## Changed

- **Anthropic prompt caching & prompt deduplication (`ModelProvider`, `SystemPrompt`, `AgentTools`)**:
  - Split Anthropic system blocks at `## Environment` to place `cache_control: ephemeral` on the static system prefix and trailing tool definition alongside the last two message turns.
  - Deduplicated overlapping tool guidance between `SystemPrompt` and `AgentTools`, relaxed rigid file-count delegation rules in favor of targeted vs. broad exploration guidance, and documented `bash` event streaming and `recall` handle formats accurately.
- **Model-facing language consistency & background prompt calibration (`SessionMemory`, `MemoryClaims`, `PostgresMemoryStore`, `MemoryMaintenance`, `MemoryPage`, `SessionTitle`, `RelatedTask`, `ConversationRecap`, `FenceHit`, `SessionStore`)**:
  - Standardized internal model-facing framing, session-note headings, and memory-extraction schemas in English while preserving backward compatibility for legacy Chinese headings/kinds (`SessionNotes.legacySectionAliases`, `MemoryKind.parse(_:)`) and localizing summary headings in the Settings UI (`MemoryPage`).
  - Calibrated `SessionTitle.refreshPrompt` length constraints per language (`zh-Hans` vs. `en`).
- **Regression test coverage**:
  - Added `HarnessPromptRegressionTests` and updated subagent, always-on agent, continuity-pack, context-breakdown, title, and localization test suites.

## Requirements

- Apple silicon Mac running macOS 27 or later.

title: Atrium 0.30.1
notes:
This maintenance release hardens Swift 6 concurrency and macOS AppKit lifecycle/accessibility behavior, replaces the two-button dirty-page prompt in Settings with a three-way confirmation (`Discard` / `Cancel` / `Save`), removes the unused SwiftUI demo app and benchmark scaffolding, and streamlines the test suite.

## Fixed

- **Settings unsaved-changes confirmation (`UnsavedSettingsCard`, `SettingsLayerView`)**:
  - Replaced the two-button (`Cancel` / `Discard`) prompt when navigating back or closing Settings on dirty secondary editor pages (`ProviderEditorCard`, `MCPEditorCard`, `RemoteHostFormCard`, `RemoteAccessPasswordCard`) with a three-way confirmation (`Discard` / `Cancel` / `Save`) matching `UnsavedEditorsCard`.
  - Disables **Save** (`canPerformSecondaryDefaultAction`) when a form cannot yet be saved, and keeps the secondary editor page open on validation failure (`performSecondaryDefaultAction() -> false`).
- **Swift 6 concurrency, actor reentrancy & lifecycle fixes**:
  - Offloaded heavy/blocking I/O and synchronous waits off `@MainActor` and cooperative executors (`RemoteAccess`, `NvimProcess`, `NvimSession`, `RemoteAccessModels`), and persisted application quit state asynchronously using `NSApplication.TerminateReply.terminateLater` in `AtriumApp` / `SessionStore`.
  - Eliminated data races and actor-reentrancy hazards (`Bonjour`, `RemoteServerCore`, `NvimProcess`, `PostgresSessionStore`, `EmbeddedPostgresHost`, `TextLayoutService`, `PostgresSyncEngine`), migrated lock sites to `Synchronization.Mutex`, and serialized sheet presentation queuing in `BrowserStore`.
  - Fixed retain cycles, callback/observer cleanup, and `isolated deinit` cleanup across `BrowserPage`, `DaemonLauncher`, `DialogCenter`, `StatusItemController`, `ConversationScrollView`, `AppearancePreference`, and `AgentWorkspaceViewController`.
- **macOS AppKit & Accessibility polish**:
  - Added Increase Contrast appearance tracking (`AppearancePreference`) and Reduce Motion support across `AtriumMotion` and `DialogCenter`.
  - Clamped default and standard zoom frames to the active screen (`MainWindowController`), paused toast dismissal timers while hovering (`NoticeCardView`), truncated overly long menu bar titles (`StatusItemController`), invalidated IME cursor coordinates on Neovim redraws (`NvimGridView`), and cleaned up `MainMenu` (removed non-functional `Customize Toolbar…`, renamed Window item to `Open Atrium`, fixed `Close` validation).

## Changed

- **Unified logging & build/signing hardening**:
  - Added `AtriumLog` (`os.Logger`, subsystem `io.github.chenkeyv.atrium`) and `StderrLog`, replacing legacy `NSLog` and direct stderr writes.
  - Added `Resources/Atrium.entitlements` for Developer ID hardened runtime, ordered Postgres `.dylib`/binary codesigning with fixed identifiers in `Makefile`, expanded CI SwiftPM cache keys, and added `script/build_and_run.sh`.
- **Demo app removal & streamlined test suite**:
  - Removed all `#if ATRIUM_DEMO` / `#if ATRIUM_PERF` SwiftUI demo app sources and demo scripts (`0` `import SwiftUI` remaining in `Sources/`).
  - Removed redundant benchmark and per-view motion tests, shortened slow polling/fixture waits, and added concurrency/lifecycle/UI/Settings regression suites (`ConcurrencyAndStorageRegressionTests`, `AuditRegressionTests`).

## Requirements

- Apple silicon Mac running macOS 27 or later.

title: Atrium 0.30.0
notes:
This update introduces a dedicated top-level **Agent** tab powered by a persistent always-on Atrium Agent running in `atriumd`, along with global shortcuts to cycle workspaces (`⌥\`` / `⇧⌥\``) and pages within a workspace (`⌘\`` / `⇧⌘\``).

## Added

- **Always-On Agent tab (`Agent` | `Tasks` | `Terminal` | `Browser`)**:
  - Added a top-level **Agent** workspace (`⌥1`), keeping **Tasks** (`⌥2`) as the default startup view and shifting **Terminal** (`⌥3`) and **Browser** (`⌥4`).
  - Backed the tab by a singleton persistent built-in `atrium` session managed by `atriumd` (`agent/ensure`, `agent/reset`), running independently outside the `Tasks` timeline while spawned workers appear in both the `Tasks` timeline and the Agent sidebar.
  - Added persistent metadata (`isAlwaysOn`, `autonomousWakePaused`, `AgentState.alwaysOn`) across JSONL history, snapshots, and PostgreSQL storage, automatically reopening interrupted always-on sessions across daemon restarts and raising the consecutive autonomous follow-up cap to `20`.
- **Agent status & control sidebar (`AgentStatusSidebarView`, `⌥⌘0`)**:
  - Hosts the conversation thread alongside a collapsible right-hand status sidebar toggled via the toolbar **Widgets** button or `⌥⌘0`.
  - Displays live status (`Online`, `Working`, `Starting`, `Needs Attention`, `Wake Paused`, `Offline`), active model configuration, working directory, context meter, live **Monitors** and **Background Tasks** with per-item Stop actions, and **Workers** (click to jump directly to the worker in `Tasks`).
  - Provides live controls for **Autonomous Wake** (`session/set_autonomous_wake` / `atrium.autonomous_wake`, immediately canceling in-flight autonomous turns when paused and resetting caps/draining pending wakes when resumed), **Auto-Resume Workers**, **Start/Stop Agent**, and **New Thread**.
- **Toolbar, menu bar & notification integration**:
  - Added live status dot and active monitor/background-task count badge on the `Agent` toolbar tab, a quick status row in the menu bar item (`StatusItemController`), notification click routing to the Agent workspace, and fallback in `Next Blocked Task` (`⌥⌘B`).
- **Workspace & page cycling shortcuts (`ShellShortcuts`, `NvimKeys`, `MainMenu`)**:
  - `⌥\`` / `⇧⌥\`` cycles forward/backward across top-level workspaces (`Agent`, `Tasks`, `Terminal`, `Browser`).
  - `⌘\`` / `⇧⌘\`` cycles forward/backward across tabs/pages within the active workspace (**Browser** tabs, **Terminal** and scratch terminal tabs, and **Tasks** in `TimelineGraphBuilder.newestFirst` order).
  - Routed `⌥1`–`⌥4`, `⌥\``, `⇧⌥\``, `⌘\``, and `⇧⌘\`` past Neovim key capture (`NvimKeys`) so shortcuts work while the embedded editor is focused.

## Changed

- Renumbered top-level workspace shortcuts to `⌥1` (`Agent`), `⌥2` (`Tasks`), `⌥3` (`Terminal`), and `⌥4` (`Browser`) across toolbar tooltips, the `View` menu, and shortcut handling.
- Updated **New Terminal Tab** (`⌘T`) enablement to stay disabled inside the `Agent` workspace.

## Requirements

- Apple silicon Mac running macOS 27 or later.

title: Atrium 0.29.4
notes:
This update separates Atrium agent's background execution into event-driven background tasks and timer-scheduled monitors, removes synchronous waiting so the main session never blocks, and replaces worker polling loops with `kqueue`-backed `DispatchSource` I/O.

## Changed

- **Event-driven background tasks (`bash(run_in_background: true)`, `BackgroundTaskManager`)**:
  - Background commands now always report lifecycle completion, failure, or timeout asynchronously, and optionally emit irregular runtime events via `event_pattern` (regular expression) or `stream_events: true` with burst debouncing and cooldown.
  - Matched runtime events are stored in a dedicated bounded event buffer (`200` entries) so noisy log rollover never evicts unread signals.
- **Timer-scheduled monitors (`monitor`, `MonitorSchedule`)**:
  - Replaced long-lived monitor shell loops with native timer-scheduled single-run checks on a configurable `interval` (`1–3600s`, non-reentrant), with per-tick `tick_timeout`, optional `max_runs`, `timeout`, and `persistent`.
  - Every tick updates the live pinned `BackgroundWorkList` strip immediately; `report_mode` (`"on_change"` default or `"always"`) and `notify` (`"agent"` default or `"ui_only"`) let monitors either wake the agent or emit lightweight UI notices without waking the LLM.
- **Non-blocking main session & independent wake budgets (`AgentSession`, `AgentTools`, `SystemPrompt`, `AgentServer`)**:
  - Removed synchronous `background_task(action="wait")` and all `Waiter` infrastructure, keeping only non-blocking `list`, `output`, and `stop`.
  - Separated `userTurnActive` from `autonomousTurnActive` so user prompts and `setOption` preempt in-flight autonomous turns cleanly instead of waiting or rejecting configuration changes.
  - Split autonomous follow-up caps between background task events and periodic monitor reports so frequent monitor ticks never starve background task completions or failures, and enabled `enableAutonomousWake: !isAuxiliary` consistently in `AgentServer`.
- **`DispatchSource` (`kqueue`) worker I/O (`BackgroundTaskManager.WorkerSession`)**:
  - Replaced `BlockingIO` + `poll(2)` / `Thread.sleep` loops with `DispatchSourceRead`, `Process.terminationHandler`, and `DispatchSourceTimer` on a serial `DispatchQueue`, eliminating per-task blocked OS threads and idle polling wakeups while preserving `2048`-byte UTF-8 codepoint-safe line truncation and process-group teardown.

## Fixed

- **Two-phase event inbox (`peekNotifications` / `ackNotifications`)**:
  - Autonomous turns now acknowledge delivered batches only after appending to session history, ensuring preempted autonomous turns never drop pending events and task completions/failures outrank routine monitor reports within the `8,192`-character batch budget without prematurely acknowledging deferred runtime events.
- **Trailing UI background list updates (`publishBackground`)**:
  - Added a trailing 500 ms scheduled flush so throttled output bursts never leave the pinned UI card stale after the final line arrives.

## Requirements

- Apple silicon Mac running macOS 27 or later.

title: Atrium 0.29.3
notes:
This update upgrades Atrium agent's window-switching context management for long-running sessions, fixes repetitive tool loops caused by dropped reasoning blocks on non-Claude Anthropic-compatible gateways, bounds screenshot and old-turn thinking growth inside a window, and improves multi-keyword memory, transcript recall, and related-task handoff.

## Fixed

- **Interleaved thinking replay on non-Claude Anthropic gateways (`ModelProvider`, `AgentSession`)**:
  - Added `StreamingProvider.requiresAnthropicThinkingSignature(model:)` so only Claude models drop unsigned `thinking` blocks. Non-Claude models running through `.anthropicMessages` gateways (such as DeepSeek, Kimi, and MiniMax) now preserve and replay their unsigned `thinking` blocks across tool calls (`replayAnthropicContent(..., allowUnsignedThinking:)`), preventing repetitive tool loops after multi-step tool batches.
- **In-window token accounting and tool image cleanup (`ContextView`)**:
  - Stopped double-counting `thinking` and `reasoning` characters in `ContextView.characters(_:)`, weighted inline message images (`* 6_400` chars), cleared replaced message `images` in `render(_:)`, and introduced `imageCleared(_:)` so older tool screenshots are stripped in both warm (`>= 4` eligible images) and cold (`>= 1` eligible image) cleanup passes while protecting the latest 3 tool calls.
- **Multi-keyword memory, child-session, and transcript search (`MemoryStore`, `PostgresMemoryStore`, `PostgresAgentHistoryStore`, `PostgresSessionStore`)**:
  - Switched search from brittle `ALL`-term matching to `ANY`-term matching scored by `unnest(...)` match counts and `filterByCoverage`, while keeping `forget()` strict `AND` matching.
  - Added explicit `::uuid` and `::text` casts on nullable exclusion parameters in `PostgresSessionStore.searchTranscripts`, and fixed `PostgresMemoryStore.search` so its claim query matches `decodeClaim`'s 12-column projection.
- **Session notes corruption guard & refresh cadence (`SessionMemory`, `AgentSession`)**:
  - Bounded `memoryInput` payloads by stripping `thinking` blocks, capping fallback `reasoning` at 500 bytes, and capping tool arguments at 1,500 bytes.
  - Added `SessionNotes.isCorruptEcho(_:)` to reject raw transcript echoes before they can overwrite `state.notes`, and updated `notesDue(history:budget:)` to trigger on long tool-heavy turns (`>= 60` messages and `>= 6,000` new tokens) as well as capped token deltas (`min(budget / 4, 24_000)`).
- **Related task handoff & continuity pack preservation (`RelatedTask`, `ContinuityPack`)**:
  - Capped `originalPrompt` at 8,000 chars and `changedFiles` diffs at 16,000 chars (deprioritizing `/tmp/` scratch paths and summarizing omitted files).
  - Included follow-up user instructions and `ask_user` decisions in `ParentTaskContext` conclusions and in `ContinuityPack` (`User decisions`), plus a bounded `[reasoning]` fallback in `ContinuityPack.lastSteps` when the latest assistant message has no visible text.

## Changed

- **500k active working window & enhanced in-window cleanup (`ContextView`, `AgentSession`, `NativeRuntime`)**:
  - Capped the active working window at 500,000 tokens (`ContextView.maxWorkingWindow`) via `workingWindow(for:)` so ultra-large models (e.g. 1M) still rotate cleanly via `ContinuityPack` before attention degrades and input costs escalate.
  - Capped `ContinuityPack` at `80_000` chars (~20k tokens), added message-count window-switch guards (`160` cold / `260` warm boundary when `estimated >= budget / 5`, and `300` mid-turn), capped the warm-clear minimum savings floor at `32_000` tokens (`min(budget * 20 / 100, 32_000)`), and persisted `clearedThinking` to strip completed earlier turns' unsigned `thinking`/`reasoning` without invalidating current-turn reasoning.

## Requirements

- Apple silicon Mac running macOS 27 or later.

title: Atrium 0.29.2
notes:
This update fixes a crash in the background agent service `atriumd` while a shell command streams more than 15 KB of output, stops a long-lived command or monitor from growing its captured tail in memory, and makes the shell's UI tests run on displays that cannot open a 1240 pt window.

## Fixed

- **Crash while streaming command output (`Support`, `ProcessRunner`)**:
  - Fixed `utf8TailText` and `boundedText` reading the trimmed tail buffer from offset 0. `Data.removeFirst` advances `startIndex`, so after the first 15 KB the next streamed read indexed past the buffer and trapped the process with a precondition failure (SIGTRAP), killing `atriumd` and every agent session it hosted. Both helpers now walk bytes from the buffer's own `startIndex`.
  - Triggered by any foreground `bash` call whose output exceeded 15 KB while `onOutput` live streaming was attached, which is every shell command run from the conversation.
- **Shell UI tests on narrower displays (`ShellAcceptanceRigTests`, `ShellLifecycleTests`)**:
  - Removed the hardcoded 1240, 1600 and 900 pt window widths. Ordering a window front fits it to the display, so on a narrower display those suites failed while the shell behaved correctly. Expectations now come from `fittedWidth` and `ShellMetrics.columnWidths` for the width the window really gets, and the centring and saved-frame suites compare against `constrainFrameRect`'s own answer.
  - The measured 620 / 960 / 465 / 413 / 360 column figures stay pinned by `columnWidthsMatchTheMeasuredOldShellWidths`, which needs no window at all.

## Changed

- **Bounded tail trimming (`ProcessRunner`)**:
  - The streamed tail is now trimmed with `removeSubrange` instead of `removeFirst`. `removeFirst` never reclaims its prefix, so a long-running command's backing store kept growing: 40 MB of output held 318 MB resident. Trimming by range keeps the buffer at its 15 KB cap, and `tailTrimmingKeepsTheBufferBaseAndItsCapacity` pins that the base offset stays at 0.

## Requirements

- Apple silicon Mac running macOS 27 or later.

title: Atrium 0.29.0
notes:
This update upgrades Atrium's built-in agent to search and recall across all synced agent transcripts, index subagent message search with PostgreSQL Schema v4, manage durable memories with direct saves, 60-day staleness tracking, and cold-reset refreshes, and hydrate Atrium sessions resumed from another synced Mac.

## Added

- **Cross-agent transcript search and verbatim recall (`PostgresSessionStore`, `AgentSession`, `AgentTools`, `SystemPrompt`)**:
  - Added `PostgresSessionStore.searchTranscripts` with multi-term `pg_trgm` query pushdown, macOS symlink path variants, and 1-based user turn calculation, plus `loadSession(nativeSessionID:)` backed by `idx_sessions_native_id`.
  - Extended `memory_search` with `all_workspaces` and `include_sessions` options to search synced Claude Code, Codex, Kiro, and Atrium transcripts alongside durable claims and compacted summaries, applying secret redaction and forgetting rules.
  - Extended `recall` to resolve `session:event:<uuid>/turn:<n>` handles from synced session transcripts and fall back to `PostgresSessionStore.loadSession(nativeSessionID:)` for unhydrated remote `session:<nativeUUID>/turn:<n>` handles.
- **Direct memory save (`AgentTools`, `AgentSession`, `MemoryClaims`, `PostgresMemoryStore`)**:
  - Added the top-level `memory_save` tool (hidden from subagents) with secret redaction, text normalization deduplication, repository/global scoping rules, and forgetting enforcement.

## Changed

- **PostgreSQL Schema v4 and indexed subagent recall (`PostgresSchema`, `PostgresAgentHistoryStore`, `AgentSession`)**:
  - Bumped `PostgresSchema.currentVersion` to `4` with LZ4-compressed `agent_messages.search_text`, an idempotent v3-to-v4 SQL backfill, `idx_agent_messages_search_trgm` (`GIN gin_trgm_ops`), and `idx_sessions_native_id`.
  - Updated parent-session `recall(query:)` to query child subagent messages and notes via indexed `PostgresAgentHistoryStore.searchChildMessages` instead of hydrating every child session history.
- **Memory staleness lifecycle and cold-reset refresh (`MemoryClaims`, `PostgresMemoryStore`, `MemoryMaintenance`, `AgentSession`)**:
  - Wired `last_verified_at` and `stale` flags across file and PostgreSQL memory stores, marking unverified `project`, `decision`, and `commitment` claims older than 60 days as stale while keeping preferences and lessons fresh.
  - Ranked non-stale claims ahead of stale ones and annotated `[stale]` in prompt summaries and search hits.
  - Refreshed `<earlier_session_notes>` inside `state.fixedPrefix` on cold context resets while keeping warm-turn prompt caches frozen, and added per-run repository scope caching in `MemoryMaintenance` and `AgentSession`.
- **Cross-device Atrium native session resume (`AtriumNativeRuntime`, `AtriumNativeConnection`, `AgentHistory`, `AgentServer`, `atriumd`)**:
  - Wired `PostgresSessionStore` through `AtriumNativeRuntime`, `AgentServer`, and `atriumd`, automatically hydrating local `agent_messages`, `agent_updates`, `ContinuityPack`, model/effort configuration, and synced session notes from PostgreSQL when resuming an Atrium session synced from another device.

## Requirements

- Apple silicon Mac running macOS 27 or later.

title: Atrium 0.28.0
notes:
This update refactors Atrium's PostgreSQL memory model into a conflict-free multi-device schema, moves memory maintenance in-process inside `atriumd` with advisory locking and event-driven wakeups, and reuses session working notes and history maps during extraction.

## Changed

- **Multi-device sync-safe PostgreSQL memory model (Schema v3, `PostgresMemoryStore`, `PostgresSyncEngine`)**:
  - Bumped `PostgresSchema.currentVersion` to `3` with automatic, idempotent v2-to-v3 backfill from legacy monolithic `memory_meta('state')` blobs.
  - Added `through_turn`, `withheld`, and `filename` columns directly on `memory_sessions`, storing unconsolidated candidates as individual `memory_claims` rows (`status = 'pending'`) so concurrent extraction on multiple Macs merges cleanly without overwriting each other.
  - Added synced `memory_watermarks` using monotonic CRDT merge (`GREATEST` on `cleared_through_turn` and date-ordered `nightly_through_turn` with zero-echo hybrid merge reconciliation) in `PostgresSyncEngine`.
  - Moved device-local operational state (`failures`, `retryAfter`, `sources_index`, and migration markers) into local-only `memory_local_state`, excluded local keys from `memory_meta` replication, and added `IS DISTINCT FROM` write guards across `PostgresMemoryStore.writeState` to eliminate cross-device sync echoes.
- **In-process memory maintenance, PG advisory locks, and event-driven scheduling (`atriumd`, `MemoryMaintenanceScheduler`, `MemoryMaintenance`, `AtriumNativeRuntime`, `PostgresDB`)**:
  - Added `PostgresDB.withAdvisoryLock(key:)` (`PostgresSchema.memoryMaintenanceLockKey`) so `MemoryMaintenance` coordinates via PostgreSQL session advisory locks with guaranteed cleanup on cancellation instead of local file locks.
  - Wired `MemoryMaintenanceScheduler` inside `atriumd` to execute in-process against the daemon's shared PostgreSQL pool and cached `AtriumNativeRuntime` provider/model catalog with a 30-minute PostgreSQL consolidation cooldown.
  - Added debounced event-driven wakeups (`notifyWorkAvailable()`) connected to `Session` / `SessionStore` task completion (`onEnded` / `onSessionEnded`), remote PostgreSQL sync pulls (`DaemonServer` / `PostgresSyncEngine`), and initial legacy migration completion.
- **Session working notes & history map reuse during extraction (`MemorySources`, `MemoryMaintenance`)**:
  - Passed redacted, forgetting- and clear-filtered `SessionNotes` and root `HistoryNode` summaries as read-only reference context during initial session extraction while preserving strict verbatim-quote validation against raw conversation messages.

## Fixed

- **Brand-new PostgreSQL database first-run maintenance (`PostgresMemoryStore`)**:
  - Replaced random fallback UUIDs on empty databases with a deterministic `defaultGeneration` sentinel so initial `MemoryMaintenance` extraction runs complete cleanly without false generation-mismatch cancellation.

## Requirements

- Apple silicon Mac running macOS 27 or later.

title: Atrium 0.27.1
notes:
This update fixes PostgreSQL recall, forgetting, and memory maintenance regressions introduced in the storage migration and eliminates hot-path transaction and query overhead across Atrium's native agent runtime.

## Fixed

- **PostgreSQL cross-session `recall` and forgetting enforcement (`AgentSession`, `PostgresMemoryStore`)**:
  - Updated `recall("session:...")` to read `MemoryStore` forgetting rules asynchronously from PostgreSQL and load referenced transcripts from `PostgresAgentHistoryStore` instead of reading missing `.jsonl` / `state.json` files on disk.
  - Updated `PostgresMemoryStore.insertForgetting` from `ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING` to `ON CONFLICT DO UPDATE` (when `reason` or `deleted_at` changes) so incremental `MemoryForgetting.throughTurns` updates persist across runs and sync.
  - Updated `PostgresMemoryStore.clear()` to capture `(session, turn)` watermarks from existing `memory_claims` and `pending` candidates alongside `sessions`, matching file-store suppression guarantees.
  - Wired `AgentServer` to construct a `PostgresMemoryStore` when an external `PostgresAgentHistoryStore` is provided, and made `MemoryMaintenanceCommand` derive its PG discovery `stateDirectory` from `ATRIUM_MEMORY_EVENT_DIRECTORY` when overridden.
- **Task deletion cleanup for `agent_sessions` (`PostgresSessionStore`)**:
  - Soft-deleting a session in `PostgresSessionStore.softDeleteSession` now also soft-deletes its orphaned `agent_sessions` and child subagent rows once no other active `sessions` row references that `nativeSessionID`, preventing deleted tasks from lingering or being re-learned by memory maintenance.

## Changed

- **PostgreSQL schema v2 migration & search indexing (`PostgresSchema`, `PostgresMemoryStore`)**:
  - Bumped `PostgresSchema.currentVersion` to `2` with additive `agent_sessions` metadata columns (`cwd_path`, `source`, `ended`, `model`, `user_turn_count`, `through_turn`, `fixed_prefix` with `lz4` compression, and `deleted_at`), automatic backfill from v1 `SessionEnvelope` JSONB rows, `parent_session_id` / top-level / `.user` transcript indexes, and combined `pg_trgm` GIN indexes (`idx_memory_claims_search_trgm`, `idx_memory_sessions_search_trgm`).
  - Updated `PostgresMemoryStore.search()` to push all search terms (`ILIKE ALL`) onto the combined GIN-indexed expressions, match both `title` and `summary` on `memory_sessions`, order session hits by `ended_at DESC NULLS LAST`, and remove dead write-only `memory_meta('summary')` updates.
- **Hot-path agent persistence & memory scanning (`PostgresAgentHistoryStore`, `AgentHistory`, `AgentSession`, `NativeRuntime`, `MemorySources`, `MemoryMaintenance`)**:
  - Coalesced streamed text, thought, and forwarded subagent chunks inside `AgentSession` before persisting `agent_updates` so token streaming emits immediately without per-chunk PostgreSQL transaction commits.
  - Separated `fixed_prefix` out of `agent_sessions.state` JSONB, added per-session serialization and sequence/existence caches in `PostgresAgentHistoryStore`, eliminated per-chunk `SELECT state::text` reads and no-op `model_usage`/`subagent_result` transactions, and combined end-of-turn `persistState()` writes.
  - Replaced N+1 full-history loading in `listTopLevelSources()` with a single metadata query scoped by the 31-day maintenance window (preserving linked `nativeSessionID`s), added selective `load(includeUpdates:includeDelegates:)` and `loadChildren()`, guarded same-ID `fork` self-locking, and skipped idle `writeStateAsync(initial)` churn in PostgreSQL mode.

## Requirements

- Apple silicon Mac running macOS 27 or later.

title: Atrium 0.27.0
notes:
This release replaces file-only session and memory persistence with a bundled, relocatable PostgreSQL 17 runtime managed by `atriumd`, adds indexed full-text search across English and Chinese transcripts, and introduces bidirectional cursor-based synchronization with an optional remote PostgreSQL server.

## Added

- **Bundled PostgreSQL 17 runtime (`EmbeddedPostgresHost`, `PostgresDB`, `PostgresSchema`, `scripts/postgres/fetch.py`)**:
  - Bundles a self-contained, relocatable PostgreSQL 17 runtime (`initdb`, `pg_ctl`, `pg_isready`, `postgres`, `pg_dump`, `pg_restore`, `pg_trgm`, ICU, LZ4, Zstd, OpenSSL, Kerberos) inside `Atrium.app/Contents/SharedSupport/Postgres`, accompanied by PostgreSQL and `postgres-nio` notices in `ThirdPartyNotices/`.
  - `EmbeddedPostgresHost` manages cluster initialization (`UTF8` / `en_US.UTF-8`), Unix Domain Socket connections (`<=95`-byte safe paths), `lz4` WAL and TOAST compression, stale `postmaster.pid` recovery (ignoring foreign `EPERM` PIDs), and clean lifecycle shutdown inside `atriumd`.
  - `PostgresSchema` runs advisory-locked migrations creating `sessions`, `transcript_items`, `agent_sessions`, `agent_messages`, `agent_updates`, `agent_delegates`, `memory_claims`, `memory_sessions`, `memory_forgetting`, `memory_meta`, and `sync_state` tables with `pg_trgm` GIN indexes and optional `pgvector` probing.
- **PostgreSQL session, internal agent, and long-term memory stores (`PostgresSessionStore`, `PostgresAgentHistoryStore`, `PostgresMemoryStore`)**:
  - Persists active sessions incrementally via `(seq, revision)` deltas, supports backward/forward `.user`-aligned pagination, full-text EN+ZH `pg_trgm` search (`history/search`), soft-delete tombstones, and immediate write-ahead persistence on turn boundaries so `SIGKILL` restarts cleanly mark interrupted turns.
  - Moves native agent continuity (`agent_sessions`, `fork` subagent scoping) and long-term memory (claims, session summaries, forgetting rules, maintenance metadata) into PostgreSQL without creating new `.jsonl` files or writing wire traces.
  - Provides non-destructive, idempotent legacy migrators (`LegacySessionMigrator`, `LegacyAgentHistoryMigrator`, `LegacyMemoryMigrator`) for existing disk histories and memory files.
- **Bidirectional remote PostgreSQL synchronization (`PostgresSyncEngine`, `StorageSyncConfigStore`)**:
  - Stores non-secret sync settings in `~/.config/atrium/storage.json` while isolating credentials in `0o600` `storage-credentials.json`.
  - Executes transactional Push-then-Pull batch sync over TLS (`disable`, `prefer`, `require`, `verify-full`) using shared monotonic `atrium_sync_seq` cursors, deterministic Last-Writer-Wins (`updated_at`, `updated_by_device_id`) conflict resolution, foreign-key-safe parent session pre-sync, tombstone propagation, zero-echo device tracking, and credential sanitization on errors.
- **Daemon Protocol v19 RPCs and Settings UI (`DaemonProtocol`, `DaemonServer`, `MemoryPage`)**:
  - Bumps `DaemonProtocol.version` to `19` with `history/search` (available locally and to remote Mac apps) and local `storage/status`, `storage/configure`, `storage/test_connection`, `storage/sync_now`, `memory/status`, and `memory/clear` RPCs.
  - Adds **Settings › Memory › Storage & Remote Sync** with local PostgreSQL 17 status and database size, remote PostgreSQL URL/password/SSL mode inputs, **Test Connection**, **Save**, and **Sync Now** controls, plus Simplified Chinese localizations.

## Changed

- **Test & CI isolation (`Makefile`, `ci.yml`, `release.yml`, `IdleSessionSwapTests`)**:
  - Updated `deps` and CI/Release workflows to stage PostgreSQL 17 before building and testing, verified relocatable `@rpath` linking and strict bundle signing in `Contents/SharedSupport/Postgres`, and isolated test daemons to dedicated state directories and ports (`ATRIUM_DISABLE_POSTGRES=1` kept where `.jsonl` wire traces are directly inspected).

## Requirements

- Apple silicon Mac running macOS 27 or later.

title: Atrium 0.26.0
notes:
This update introduces Atrium's native in-process agent runtime inside `atriumd`, adds background tasks, event monitors, `ask_user`, and `web_fetch` tools, and upgrades conversation formatting and built-in tool ergonomics across the board.

## Added

- **Native in-process Atrium agent runtime (`AgentProtocol.native`, `AtriumNativeRuntime`, `AtriumNativeConnection`, `atriumd`)**:
  - Runs the built-in `atrium` agent directly inside `atriumd` without launching per-session `atrium-agent` subprocesses or JSON-RPC stdio hops, while preserving standalone ACP CLI/custom-command fallback.
  - Adds shared TTL-cached and in-flight-coalesced `ModelCatalog` provider model lookups, direct in-process `DaemonServer` bridges (`directAutomation(for:)`, `directChief(for:)`), typed `DirectAtriumConnection.contextSection(_:)` and `CreateElicitationRequest` routing, native `forkSession`, and skip-replay `continueSession(..., replay: false)`.
  - Adds event-driven autonomous idle wakeups for background completions and monitor events with stoppable `BackgroundWork.Kind.turn` progress rows, user-prompt preemption, and a consecutive autonomous turn cap.
- **Background tasks and event monitors (`BackgroundTaskManager`, `monitor`, `background_task`)**:
  - Supports asynchronous `bash` (`run_in_background: true`) commands and event-streaming `monitor` scripts with Seatbelt sandbox enforcement parity, incremental cursors (`background_task` `list`, `output`, `wait`, `stop`), unread event injection, live output previews and Stop controls in `PinnedWorkView`, `_atrium/stop_background_work` RPC support, and orphan process-group cleanup on session close.
- **Interactive `ask_user` and `web_fetch` tools**:
  - Exposes `ask_user` on root sessions supporting `elicitation` (via typed in-process callbacks or ACP `elicitation/create`) with single-select, multi-select, and optional custom notes.
  - Adds `web_fetch` (`WebFetch`) for bounded streaming HTTP/HTTPS page fetching (2 MB cap), strict redirect validation, and readable HTML text extraction.

## Changed

- **Conversation polish and upgraded built-in tools (`SystemPrompt`, `AgentTools`, `ShellContext`, `Support`)**:
  - Refined `SystemPrompt` formatting guidance, `#L<line>` editor link jumping in `ShellContext`, UTF-8 codepoint-safe `boundedText` and background line truncation, and live foreground `bash` streaming.
  - Upgraded `read` (local `.png`/`.jpg`/`.gif`/`.webp` images, EOF hints, pagination cursors), `edit` (diagnostics, CRLF/LF mismatch hints, unified patches for large files), `grep` (`glob`, `caseInsensitive`, `literal`, `context`, `mode`, directory-safe `skipDescendants`), `list` (`depth`), and `bash` (`cwd`, `description`, `rawOutput`).

## Fixed

- **Cross-thread socket metrics race (`UnixSocketPeer.metrics`)**: Replaced `ObservationRegistrar` on lock-protected counters with lock-serialized `observeMetrics` subscriptions invoked outside `self.lock`.

## Requirements

- Apple silicon Mac running macOS 27 or later.

title: Atrium 0.25.6
notes:
This update adds automatic idle session title refreshing using the configured memory model, along with a synced General Settings toggle and multi-turn title prompts.

## Added

- **Automatic idle title refresh (`Session`, `SessionStore`)**: Automatically refreshes unlocked task titles 3 seconds after a completed turn (`finishTurn(.endTurn)`) returns to `.idle` with no queued messages, pending permissions, or elicitations. Auto-refreshed titles stay unlocked so subsequent turns can refine the title while suppressing late agent-proposed `session_info_update` titles for the same turn; manually renamed, manually refreshed, or chief-assigned (`setInitialTitle`) titles remain locked, and demo/subagent/restored/cancelled/failed/usage-limited turns are skipped silently without showing a header spinner or error notice.
- **Auto-refresh title setting & daemon sync (`GeneralPage`, `DaemonServer`, `DaemonProtocol`, `DaemonChange`)**: Added an **Auto-refresh title** toggle (`autoRefreshTitleOnIdle`, enabled by default) in **Settings › General** with Simplified Chinese localization, persisted in daemon `UserDefaults`, synced across `DaemonSnapshot` / `DaemonChange` (including the web client sync layer), and updated via the `settings/set_auto_refresh_title` RPC (allowed for local and remote Mac app connections, refused for browser remote, MCP, and automation connections).

## Changed

- **Multi-turn title refresh prompt (`SessionTitle.refreshPrompt`)**: Includes the latest distinct user message alongside the first user message and latest assistant reply (each bounded to `excerptLength`) so later-turn refreshes reflect how the conversation evolved.

## Requirements

- Apple silicon Mac running macOS 27 or later.

title: Atrium 0.25.5
notes:
This update adds end-to-end Kitty Graphics Protocol support and comprehensive terminal image pasting, supporting both Kitty clipboard/paste events (`OSC 5522` / `DEC mode 5522`) and standard macOS paste and drag-and-drop workflows.

## Added

- **Kitty Graphics Protocol (`TerminalHost`, `TerminalRelay`, `TerminalReplay`, `TerminalFrame`)**: Propagates PTY pixel dimensions (`ws_xpixel`, `ws_ypixel`) across `terminal/create`, `terminal/attach`, `TerminalSavedRecord`, `TerminalPTY`, and 4- or 8-byte binary resize frames (`pixelSize` handshake negotiation for backwards compatibility), configures an explicit 320 MB `image-storage-limit` in `GhosttyConfiguration`, and filters replayed `APC G` streams so queries (`a=q`, including continuations) are stripped while image uploads retain only `q=2` on opening chunks.
- **Kitty Clipboard Protocol & Paste Events (`OSC 5522`, `DEC mode 5522`, `GhosttyRuntime`, `TerminalSurfaceView`)**: Supports `CSI ? 5522 h` paste event notifications and `pw`-authenticated follow-up reads via a 15-second snapshotted `pasteGrant` (`TerminalPasteSnapshot`) with lazy ImageIO PNG transcoding and multi-MIME clipboard writes (`TerminalClipboard.write`).
- **Standard Image Paste & Drag-and-Drop (`TerminalClipboard`, `TerminalSurfaceView`)**: Handles `⌘V`, **Edit › Paste** / **Paste and Match Style**, context-menu **Paste**, `NSMenuItemValidation`, and Finder/image drag-and-drop—saving raw PNG/TIFF clipboard images to private temporary `.png` files (`0700`/`0600`, auto-pruned) and pasting shell-escaped paths, prioritizing Finder `file://` URLs over bare filename/icon types and disabling local temp-file fallback on remote terminals (`opensFileLinks == false`).

## Changed

- **Clipboard Security & Paste Flow Control (`GhosttyConfiguration`, `TerminalClipboardPolicy`, `TerminalHost`)**: Enables `clipboard-read = ask` so Ghostty's `pw`-authenticated `OSC 5522` paste grants work while ungranted `OSC 52` / `OSC 5522` reads route to `confirm_read_clipboard_cb` and are unconditionally denied, and adds `TerminalConnection` `DispatchSourceRead` backpressure (`1 MiB` pause / `512 KiB` resume / `4 MiB` hard limit) so large base64 image pastes stream cleanly without disconnecting.

## Fixed

- **Direct Tunnel Socket Fallback (`DirectTunnel`)**: Reserved 16 hex characters (matching `UInt64` FNV-1a tags) when checking the 104-byte Unix socket path limit before falling back to `/tmp`.

## Requirements

- Apple silicon Mac running macOS 27 or later.

title: Atrium 0.25.4
notes:
This update relaxes remote access network restrictions so any reachable IPv4/IPv6 network address or reverse proxy can connect while keeping TLS 1.3, password/lockout, certificate pinning, and CSRF protections intact, and drops the legacy network scope model.

## Changed

- **Wildcard dual-stack binding (`RemoteHostBinding`, `RemoteServer`, `BonjourRecordCodec`)**: Remote access now listens on `0.0.0.0` and `::` (with `IPV6_V6ONLY` when IPv4 is also bound, graceful fallback on IPv4-only systems, and IPv4-mapped IPv6 client address normalization) instead of restricting listeners to per-scope addresses; isolated test-harness runs remain on `127.0.0.1`. Bonjour continues advertising on the local network when binding wildcard addresses.
- **Reachable address display (`RemoteHostBinding`, `RemoteAddressFormat`, `RemotePage`)**: `remote/status` lists all reachable non-loopback IPv4 and IPv6 addresses (Tailscale IPv4/IPv6, private LAN IPv4, public/other routable IPv4 & IPv6) plus `127.0.0.1`, filtering out unspecified, APIPA, proxy fake-IP TUN (`198.18.0.0/15`), multicast, reserved, and link-local IPv6 addresses. **Settings › Remote** labels Tailscale, Local Network, and Localhost (`本机`) addresses, truncates long IPv6 endpoints in the middle, and updates the subtitle in English and Simplified Chinese.
- **Reverse-proxy & cross-site navigation support (`RemoteOriginCheck`, `DirectTunnel`)**: Safe static `GET`/`HEAD` requests to Atrium Web are allowed across `Sec-Fetch-Site` while `POST` mutations and WebSocket upgrades continue enforcing same-origin checks. `Origin` validation normalizes case and default ports (`:443`/`:80`) and matches against `Host`, `X-Forwarded-Host`, `X-Forwarded-Port`, `X-Forwarded-Proto`, and RFC 7239 `Forwarded`. Direct Mac connections now send TLS SNI (for DNS hostnames) and the actual target `Host` header so domain-based reverse proxies work out of the box.

## Removed

- **Legacy network scopes (`RemoteScope`, `scopes`)**: Removed `RemoteScope`, the `scopes` field/parameter from `RemoteConfig`, `RemoteAccessStatus`, `remote/set_config`, and `SessionStore.setRemoteAccess`, and the **Scope** checkboxes from **Settings › Remote › Advanced…** (existing `config.json` files continue decoding cleanly while ignoring legacy keys).

## Requirements

- Apple silicon Mac running macOS 27 or later.

title: Atrium 0.25.3
notes:
This update reworks window background transparency and background blur after iTerm2's AppKit and CoreGraphics implementation.

## Changed

- **Pure alpha window backdrop (`WindowBackdropView`, `WindowChrome`)**: Replaced behind-window `NSVisualEffectView` material with a single non-animated alpha canvas layer over a `0.01`-alpha near-clear window backing color (`WindowChrome.translucentWindowBackgroundColor`) with explicit shadow invalidation on opaque transitions and automatic solid-canvas fallback in native full screen.
- **WindowServer Gaussian blur (`WindowBackgroundBlur`)**: Dynamically resolves `CGSDefaultConnectionForThread` / `CGSMainConnectionID` and `CGSSetWindowBackgroundBlurRadius` from `ApplicationServices.framework`, applies iTerm2's per-window `_minBlur` workaround so toggling blur off and back on never breaks WindowServer blur, and re-synchronizes blur across window presentation, key activation, deminiaturization, and full-screen transitions in both main and auxiliary windows.
- **Full `0%–100%` translucency & sticky bar clipping**: Removed the previous `15%` / `35%` material opacity floors across `WindowTranslucencyPreferences` and `TranslucencyScale`, and clipped scrolled conversation rows behind the pinned sticky tool bar (`TopEdgeFade.coveredTop`) without a separate behind-window material view.

## Added

- **Background blur and blur radius settings (`GeneralPage`)**: Added a **Background blur** toggle (`translucentWindowBlur`, enabled by default) and a **Blur radius** slider (`1–64`, `translucentWindowBlurRadius`, default `20`) in **Settings › General**, with automatic enablement gating (blur toggle disabled at `0%` translucency; blur radius slider disabled at `0%` or when blur is off), Simplified Chinese localization, and KVO synchronization in Ghostty and embedded Neovim views.

## Requirements

- Apple silicon Mac running macOS 27 or later.

title: Atrium 0.25.2
notes:
This update fixes spacing and alignment inside the top-bar workspace switcher.

## Fixed

- **Workspace tab spacing (`ToolbarViewTabsView`)**: Replaced default `NSButton` image/title layout with a dedicated `ToolbarTabButton` layout that enforces uniform outer (`2 pt`), inter-segment (`2 pt`), horizontal (`10 pt`), icon-to-title (`5 pt`), title-to-dot (`6 pt`), and dot-to-count (`4 pt`) spacing with symmetric padding across Tasks, Terminal, and Browser tabs in both English and Simplified Chinese.
- **Stable widths & alignment**: Accounted for `NSTextField` alignment rect insets and SF Symbol full image sizes, and reserved medium-weight title width so switching between workspaces no longer shifts adjacent tabs.

## Requirements

- Apple silicon Mac running macOS 27 or later.

title: Atrium 0.25.1
notes:
This update adds direct keyboard shortcuts for switching top-level workspaces and selecting Terminal and Browser tabs.

## Added

- **Workspace switching with `⌥1` / `⌥2` / `⌥3`**: Switch between **Tasks** (`⌥1`), **Terminal** (`⌥2`), and **Browser** (`⌥3`) from any window (main window, Scratch Terminal, and Software Update) and any focused input surface (composer, Ghostty terminal, `WKWebView`, or embedded Neovim), without leaking Option characters or Meta escape sequences, while yielding when a modal dialog or Settings layer is open.
- **Terminal and Browser tab switching with `⌘1`–`⌘9`**: Added `Terminal › Switch Tab` (`Tab 1`–`Tab 8` and `Last Tab` on `⌘9`) and view-level `⌘1`–`⌘9` handling in `TerminalDrawerView` and `BrowserWorkspaceView`. Standalone terminals (global Terminal workspace and Scratch Terminal) always respond to `⌘1`–`⌘9`, while the per-task terminal drawer intercepts them only when focus is inside the drawer so `⌘1` continues toggling the timeline in conversation and editor views.
- **Toolbar hints & localization**: Updated the workspace tab tooltips (`Tasks (⌥1)`, `Terminal (⌥2)`, `Browser (⌥3)`) with Simplified Chinese translations and automatically focus the global terminal when switching to it via `⌥2`.

## Requirements

- Apple silicon Mac running macOS 27 or later.

title: Atrium 0.25.0
notes:
This update adds production MCP, Skills, and `AGENTS.md` / `CLAUDE.md` support across Atrium and its built-in agent, and changes new sessions to use the chosen folder directly without creating a Git worktree by default.

## Added

- **MCP server management and runtime support**:
  - Added `MCPStore` and `MCPServerConfig` in `AtriumCore` supporting native arrays, Claude Desktop / Cursor `{"mcpServers": {...}}` and `{"servers": {...}}` objects, stdio (`command`, `args`, `env`, `cwd`) and remote HTTP/SSE (`url`, `headers`) transports, workspace `.mcp.json` and `.atrium/mcp.json` merging with sandbox fence checks, reserved server filtering (`atrium`, `atrium_screen`), and `0600` atomic saves in `~/.config/atrium/mcp.json`.
  - Built `MCPHub`, `MCPStdioClient`, and `MCPHTTPClient` in `AtriumAgent` with concurrent session startup, per-server timeouts and failure isolation, JSON-RPC 2.0 cursor-paginated `tools/list` and `resources/list`, cancellation notifications, Streamable HTTP + `text/event-stream` SSE parsing, `Mcp-Session-Id` propagation, collision-safe tool name prefixing, read-only hint classification for `explore` subagents, `mcp_resources_list` / `mcp_resource_read` resource helpers, and connection probing.
  - Forwarded configured enabled MCP servers into compatible external ACP agent sessions via `Session.openingMCPServers()`, and redacted MCP credentials and sensitive headers across `Session` ACP traces and `AgentSession` histories and tool outputs.
  - Added AppKit MCP management UI in **Settings › Agent** (`MCPEditorCard`, `MCPRowView`) with Stdio/HTTP configuration, inline enable/disable and removal, and live **Test Connection** probing.
- **Skills discovery and invocation**:
  - Added `SkillCatalog` in `AtriumCore` to discover `SKILL.md` skills and Markdown commands across workspace (`.atrium/skills`, `.agents/skills`, `.claude/skills`, `.codex/skills`, `.claude/commands`) and user (`~/.config/atrium/skills`, `~/.atrium/skills`, `~/.agents/skills`, `~/.claude/skills`, `~/.codex/skills`) locations with case-insensitive workspace precedence and SandboxFence credential protection.
  - Integrated skills into the built-in `atrium` agent: system prompt `Available skills` summary, built-in `skill` tool (available in both normal and `explore` subagent modes), ACP `.availableCommands` advertisement, and `/<skill>` slash command autocompletion and inline skill expansion.
  - Added **Skills & Instructions** status and quick shortcuts (`Open Skills Folder`, `Edit Global AGENTS.md`) to **Settings › Agent**.
- **`AGENTS.md` and `CLAUDE.md` instructions**:
  - Updated `SystemPrompt` to load global (`~/.config/atrium/` and fallbacks) and Git-root-to-working-directory instruction hierarchies (`AGENTS.override.md`, `AGENTS.md`, `CLAUDE.md`, `.claude/CLAUDE.md`, `.atrium/AGENTS.md`, and `*.local.md`), expand `@path` / `@"path"` imports outside code fences and inline code with cycle/size/fence guards, and lazily attach unseen subdirectory `AGENTS.md` / `CLAUDE.md` rules when reading, searching, or editing files inside nested folders.

## Changed

- **New sessions default to no Git worktree**: Updated `NewTaskCard` so `New worktree` starts unchecked, opening new tasks directly in the selected folder unless a separate worktree is explicitly requested.

## Requirements

- Apple silicon Mac running macOS 27 or later.

title: Atrium 0.24.5
notes:
This update polishes the native AppKit conversation interface across turn rendering, scrolling, tool previews, the composer, and task chrome.

## Improved

- Render image attachment strips on user prompts (`PromptAttachmentStripView`, 96 pt expanded / 48 pt folded, up to four thumbnails plus a `+N` overflow badge) with click-to-Quick-Look preview, and add 16 pt horizontal overflow fades and 1.5 s `"Copied"` feedback to `CodeBlockView`.
- Add a floating `ScrollToBottomButton` pill (`Jump to latest`) with a running-turn indicator in `ConversationScrollView`, and support `"Copy Turn as Markdown"` from `StickyToolBar` and `"Open in Terminal"` on command `ToolRowView` rows.
- Animate `FieldPlate` focus, disabled, and image-drag target borders in `ComposerView`, add horizontal wheel scrolling to `AttachmentStripView`, and add a scroll-position thumb indicator to overflowing `CompletionListView` popovers.
- Focus the first invalid control and announce validation errors in `ElicitationCardView`, clear validation errors immediately on edit, tick live expiration countdowns every second, and preserve in-progress elicitation cards across queue count and fence updates in `TaskTailView`.
- Add horizontal overflow edge-fade masks and vertical wheel passthrough to `SessionConfigurationPanel`, semantic status colors and appearance-aware symbol attachments to `ConfigOptionMenuView`, SF Symbol disclosure chevrons and dynamic row heights to `ChiefWorkbenchView`, and consistent hover/pointing-hand states across task chrome controls.

## Fixed

- Fix `TopEdgeFade` limit updates, flipped clip-view mask polarity, and `contentInsets.top` accounting, and skip `ComposerScrollView` and nested scroll views when attaching column fades in `ColumnContainerView`.
- Fix `RollingThoughtPreviewView` flipped coordinates and theme colors, `RollingSubtaskPreviewView` narrow-width truncation and trailing commas, `RollingToolPreviewView` timer cleanup and 1 Hz relayout, and stationary `.began` (`deltaY == 0`) trackpad gesture handoff in `RollingToolWheelRouter`.
- Retain `SummaryBarView` usage tooltip strings across AppKit tooltip registration, remove the 8 pt empty-chip indent, preserve `ToolPartView` text selection across async syntax highlighting, and cancel stale highlight tasks on `ToolRowView` reuse.
- Filter non-image Finder file icons out of `ComposerPasteboard.pictures()`, guard ghost text against the macOS Accent Picker and IME mark transitions, align multi-line `QueuedMessageRow` text to the top line, and clamp narrow status labels.
- Keep `PinnedWorkView` ticking until retained finished items expire even after all running items complete, forward `translucent` and workspace `folder` into `PinnedSubagentExpansionView`, and scope `PermissionCardView` key equivalents so they never intercept IME, terminal, button, or active non-empty composer input.

## Requirements

- Apple silicon Mac running macOS 27 or later.
